M_beta.quote: similar to beta version 2 or b2 version of NSD experiment
M_beta.interpretation: b2 = NSD betas_fithrf; 'similar to b2' is NOT a claim of the exact released file

M_voxel.quote: voxels whose SNR exceeded the 98th percentile of all voxelwise SNR values in that ROI
M_voxel.interpretation: Dataset-1 (NSD-Imagery) uses 98th pct of NSD-core SNR per ROI; DISTINCT from Dataset-2 80th pct

M_ridge.quote: logarithmically spaced range of 100 values between 10^-3 and 10^5

M_scale.quote: the columns of Rvis and Rim are centered and scaled so that the intercept terms can be omitted
M_scale.interpretation: centered+scaled; train-only vs whole-data scope NOT stated

M_vis2img_pairing.quote: For a fixed seen/imagined stimulus, vision trial repeats were paired with randomly-selected imagery trial repeats

M_vis2vis_pairing.quote: shuffling was performed within each data split to prevent data leakage
M_vis2vis_pairing.interpretation: within-split random shuffle to build the permuted vision matrix

M_denoise_input.quote: denoised vision trials (outputs of the vis2vis model) were used as inputs to the vis2img model
M_denoise_input.interpretation: two-stage; train-set denoising dependency graph NOT precisely stated

M_rank.quote: average of the values at 99% of the peak (dots) of each curve
M_rank.interpretation: dimensionality = 99%-of-peak rank on the VALIDATION curve, averaged across 4 folds
